"""Auditor probe: model paced at a fixed rate on loopback; observe load deadline and retry."""
import glob, json, os, sys, threading, time
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
MBPS = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2.5
SITE = Path(glob.glob(r"<owned local path>")[0])
MODEL = "/assets/models/Xenova/detr-resnet-50/onnx/model_quantized.onnx"
transfers = []; stop = threading.Event()
class H(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        if urlsplit(self.path).path != MODEL: return super().do_GET()
        p = SITE / MODEL.lstrip("/"); rec = {"bytes": 0, "size": p.stat().st_size, "t0": time.time()}; transfers.append(rec)
        try:
            self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(rec["size"])); self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store"); self.end_headers()
            st = time.perf_counter()
            with p.open("rb") as f:
                while b := f.read(65536):
                    due = st + (rec["bytes"] + len(b)) / (MBPS * 125000)
                    if stop.wait(max(0, due - time.perf_counter())): break
                    self.wfile.write(b); rec["bytes"] += len(b)
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, ConnectionAbortedError): rec["aborted"] = True
srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), partial(H, directory=str(SITE)))
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
os.environ.update(SE_CACHE_PATH=r"<owned local path>", SE_OFFLINE="true", SE_AVOID_STATS="true")
o = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
for f in ["--headless=new", "--window-size=1440,1000", "--host-resolver-rules=MAP * ~NOTFOUND, EXCLUDE localhost, EXCLUDE 127.0.0.1"]: o.add_argument(f)
d = webdriver.Chrome(options=o)
def snap():
    return d.execute_script("return {state: document.documentElement.dataset.state, err: document.getElementById('error-message').textContent, stage: document.getElementById('model-loading-stage').textContent, detail: document.getElementById('model-loading-detail').textContent, loadingHidden: document.getElementById('model-loading').hidden}")
try:
    t0 = time.time(); d.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}")
    last = None
    while time.time() - t0 < 240:
        s = snap()
        if s != last: print(f"{time.time()-t0:6.1f}s", json.dumps(s), flush=True); last = s
        if s["state"] in ("error", "ready"): break
        time.sleep(1)
    print("transfer1", {k: v for k, v in transfers[0].items() if k != "t0"} if transfers else None)
    if snap()["state"] == "error":
        d.find_element(By.ID, "retry-detection").click(); t1 = time.time(); time.sleep(8)
        print("after retry +8s", json.dumps(snap()), "transfers", len(transfers), "new transfer bytes", transfers[-1]["bytes"] if transfers else None)
finally:
    stop.set(); d.quit(); srv.shutdown()
